title: Villi from the small intestine
creator: S. Schuller
changes: Archive IIIF derivative downloaded at native1024px width; no local crop, color change or upscaling
identification_basis: Owning catalogue identifies human small-intestinal mucosa cryosections, with green integrin, blue cytokeratin and red nuclei signals.
root_observation: Finger-like tissue projections with blue epithelial borders, numerous red nuclei and green signal along portions of the margins and internal tissue.
source_access: Owning HTML challenged direct web access; public owning catalogue API, image location license and IIIF native dimensions were read directly. Indexed owning description also checked.
limits: Donor condition, exact intestinal segment, detailed protocol and calibrated physical scale not established.
Assigned marker colors are not natural living tissue colors; integrin signal also occurs in stromal cells.
Photo does not identify individual GLUT/SGLT transporters or resolve transport kinetics, brush-border microvilli or clinical disease.
acquisition_status: Acquired for later Chapter12 integration; scientific/production acceptance separate
